summary: Pro can now build a management report as a PowerPoint and mail it every month.

new.title: Management report as a PowerPoint
new.text: In Pro, build a PowerPoint under Reports > Management report from the sections and period you pick.

new.title: Monthly report by mail
new.text: Mail a monthly report to the people you choose. It is off by default.

fixes.title: Missing figures are labelled
fixes.text: A report figure that cannot be read says so instead of showing 0.
